goal: Make AlembicPlugin a complete Codex-facing cold-start experience for creating Alembic knowledge and exposing source graph relationship capabilities that improve Recipe production.
nonGoals: Do not replace Recipe judgement with graph indexing.
Do not remove Recipes, Guard, Decision Register, Dashboard, daemon, or useful current MCP behavior as a shortcut; do remove stale or overlapping Codex-facing MCP routes when replacement routes exist.
Do not keep old broken MCP fields unless a current consumer requires them.
Do not treat source graph output as acceptance evidence without tests, Guard, or runtime validation.

demands.title: CKG3 Bootstrap To Recipe Production Integration
demands.purpose: Connect bootstrap gates, staged domain SOPs, source graph evidence, dimension plans, source refs, submit_knowledge, and dimension_complete into a reliable Codex Recipe production loop.
requiredEvidence: Bootstrap state, initial tool briefing, current domain SOP, and next-domain SOP before/after comparison
Bootstrap gates and staged domain SOP rules are enforced by submit_knowledge and dimension_complete, not only described in prompt text

Main cold-start gate parity matrix proving Codex host-agent, daemon/job, and shared Core paths use the same scope, graph, domain-analysis, Recipe-judgement, submission, rejection, dimension, and finalizer gates or explicitly block weaker paths
Core-owned hard evidence gate invoked from the real host-agent submit_knowledge path before persistence
Evidence gate code anchors covering source ref parsing, project-scope validation, file/line existence, snippet matching, placeholder rejection, graph-ref validation, and skipConsolidation non-bypass

Kind-aware evidence floors enforced: pattern/rule cross-module claims require >=3 distinct file refs or an explicitly declared narrower scope; fact requires >=1 precise ref; padding refs fail snippet/validity checks; tests cover a 2-file cross-module pattern rejection and a declared single-file rule acceptance

Recoverable bootstrapSessionRef and resume-after-MCP-restart proof: session state is reconstructed from persisted dimension checkpoints plus session-bound candidate ids, and session TTL refreshes on activity
Bootstrap lease enforcement: a concurrent second bootstrap attempt is rejected with a stable busy/lease state or takes over only per the explicit takeover rule
Dimension completion tests with graph evidence refs
dimension_complete computes candidate count from verified session-bound recipe ids, not caller-provided candidateCount
dimension_complete blocks checkpoint/progress writes when verified candidate minimum, referencedFiles, keyFindings, source/graph refs, or quality pass are missing
Knowledge submission tests with source evidence coverage
Recipe quality gate tests reject generic, thin, fake, duplicate, source-mismatched, and non-actionable candidates even when field-level validation and candidate count pass

Rejected Recipe candidates return rebuild-required clean output with candidate index/title, stable reason code, missing evidence or quality dimension, SOP section to rerun, and whether the current domain analysis must be repeated
Rejected Recipe candidates are not persisted as staged knowledge and do not count toward dimension_complete

Positive rich Recipe samples demonstrate real source anchors, domain context, call-chain or graph evidence where applicable, when-to-use guidance, when-not-to-use guidance, validation guidance, edge/failure guidance, and future-agent actionability
Repair-loop proof showing low-quality Recipe output triggers rework/rebuild guidance instead of becoming accepted progress

Failure tests for missing session, missing sourceRefs, bare filenames, out-of-root refs, nonexistent files, missing/out-of-range lines, snippet mismatch, placeholder code, insufficient evidence, stale graph, wrong scope, qualityReport.pass=false, and skipConsolidation bypass attempts

Positive Plugin MCP route proof from bootstrap state and current domain SOP to relationship tool inspection, submit_knowledge, dimension_complete, next-domain SOP handoff, checkpoint readback, and post-bootstrap staged-vs-active knowledge status for at least one real dimension
